messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] model-family RPM spike detected for 'zephyr' family (zephyr-13b). 4x baseline RPM, tail latency rising, ~25% error rate on generation path. Auto-mitigation not yet applied. https://metrics.redwood.local/alerts/ALRT-9271

sara: Taking this. Seeing elevated customer 429s in prod. Any immediate playbook recs? cc @raj

ops-bot: Playbook 'per-model-rate-protect' suggestions:
- soft-limit rpm -> 700 for model_family=zephyr
- disable funcall for zephyr family (reduces downstream infra)
- enable fallback routing to sable13b for non-enterprise tenants
Use `rkctl` or PATCH /internal/quota to apply.

raj: +1 on soft-limit first. Lower RPM and keep function-calls enabled unless errors spike. Funcall disable can break customers. Recommend rpm=700, rpm_window=60s, monitor 5m.

julia: Support update: ACME and Nimbus reporting increased 429s and timeouts since 09:02 UTC. ACME is high priority (account tier: Enterprise). They've filed incident #INC-4482.

sara: Applying soft-limit now for zephyr family for non-enterprise tenants. Command (internal):
```
curl -X PATCH "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/quotas" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_family":"zephyr","scope":"non_enterprise","rpm":700,"rpm_window_s":60}'
```

ops-bot: Quota change accepted. Job id=job-9a3f. Scheduling: rolling apply to edge controllers. Estimated completion 45s.

ops-bot: Job job-9a3f completed. New effective RPM for zephyr (non-enterprise): 700 rpm (60s window).

sara: Observing drop in incoming zephyr RPM now. Errors trending down from 25% -> 8% in last 3m. Latency p95 also improving.

mike: Handoff note: I'll take the next 30m watch. Sara — please summarise actions + any customers to escalate. I'll keep an eye on ACME.

sara: Handoff: applied non-enterprise zephyr rpm=700 (job-9a3f). Did not disable funcalls. Notified ACME support and linked INC-4482. Monitoring window 30m. If errors <2% and p95 stable for 15m, plan to relax to 1200 rpm and re-evaluate. If errors spike or enterprise customers affected, revert and open pager.

julia: Confirmed ACME on-call acknowledged our mitigation. They reported temporary reduction in 429s at 09:12 UTC.

raj: Also started a targeted prefetch bypass for zephyr models on internal cache layer to reduce KV pressure. No customer-facing change.

mike: Noted. I'll watch for any regressions and will escalate if enterprise impact rises. Assign postmortem owner? Sara volunteer?

sara: I'll own the postmortem. Initial notes added to INC-4482: root suspect - sudden burst from a third-party analytics app + lack of aggressive per-tenant throttles on zephyr.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4482 updated: mitigation applied, severity -> degraded, assignee=sara.

mike: Thanks. :thumbsup: If things look stable at 09:45 UTC, I'll close the thread and we can schedule the retro.

sara: Sounds good. Leaving monitoring alerts on. If anyone needs the exact rollout logs: job-9a3f logs at https://logs.redwood.internal/job-9a3f

ops-bot: Reminder: playbook step remaining -> review tenant throttles and add exception rules for enterprise accounts before increasing rpm.

mike: Copy. Handoff complete.
